title: Cover Picture and Issue Information
content:
Cover image: Marasmius bambusiniformis on a decaying leaf. Decaying wood and fallen leaves serve as the important substrate for saprophytic macrofungi. However, under intensive urban green space management practices, such organic debris is routinely removed. (pp. 3525–3536).
